properties.label: Target Form
properties.description:
Select the Joget form where Microsoft Calendar event data will be loaded.

Important:
• The selected form must be the current form where this binder is applied.
• Field mappings below will refer to columns from this form only.
• Existing records will be updated if the Event ID already exists.

properties.label: Basic Event Fields
properties.description:
Map form fields used to Load basic Microsoft Calendar event details.

Includes:
• Event subject (title).
• Location (physical or online).
• Description or agenda text.

Notes:
• All fields are optional, but mapping is recommended for complete synchronization.
• Values are stored as plain text.

properties.label: Date & Time Fields
properties.description:
Configure how event start and end date/time values are loaded in the form.

All-Day Events:
• Uses From Date and To Date fields.
• Date format must be yyyy-MM-dd.

Timed Events:
• Uses From Date Time and To Date Time fields.
• Values include both date and time.

Important:
• Date-only and Date-Time fields must be separate.
• The system automatically chooses which fields to use based on the All-Day flag.

properties.label: Flags & Metadata
properties.description:
Boolean flags derived from Microsoft Calendar event properties.

Expected Field Type:
• Boolean (true/false).

Fields:
• All Day – Indicates an all-day event.
• Enable Meeting – Indicates if a Teams meeting exists.
• Is Recurring – Indicates if the event is part of a series.

properties.label: Participants Mapping
properties.description:
Participants extracted from the Microsoft Calendar event.

Internal Participants:
• Must contain email addresses only.
• Emails are matched against Joget users.
• Stored as ; (semicolon) separated values.

External Participants:
• Email addresses not found in Joget user directory.
• Also stored as ; separated values.

Recommended Field Type:
• Multi-select, text field, or checkbox group supporting semicolon-separated values.

properties.label: Recurrence Mapping
properties.description:
Fields used to populate recurring event information from Microsoft Calendar.

Recurrence Type:
• Recommended as a dropdown/checkbox field.
• Supported values include daily, weekly, monthly, yearly.

Recurrence Interval:
• Must be a numeric field.
• Defines frequency (e.g. every 2 weeks).

Recurrence Days:
• Required for weekly recurrence.
• Values must be lowercase day names (e.g. monday;wednesday).
• Use multi-select or checkbox fields.

Recurrence End Date:
• Date-only field.
• Format must be yyyy-MM-dd.

properties.label: Extended Property (Single Value)
properties.description:
Microsoft Graph singleValueExtendedProperty used to sync custom application metadata.

Purpose:
• Store a unique business identifier (e.g. Matter ID, Reference ID).
• Enables filtering and linking events across systems.

GUID Guidelines:
• Must be a valid UUID format.
• Example: 8F6C2F2A-4D4E-4C7C-A0E2-1F6E6C2A9C11
• The GUID should remain constant once configured.

Property Name (ID) Guidelines:
• Must be a single identifier (no spaces).
• Use alphanumeric characters only.
• Recommended format: camelCase (e.g. matterId).

Rules:
• Only one value is supported per event.
• Do NOT use separators such as ;, ,, or |.
• Stored as plain text in the mapped form field.

properties.label: Microsoft Metadata
properties.description:
Optional fields used to store additional Microsoft Calendar metadata in Joget.

Includes:
• Organizer email address.
• Series Master ID for recurring events.
• Microsoft Outlook event URL.
• Microsoft Teams meeting join link.

Notes:
• All mappings are optional.
• Useful for reporting, navigation, and troubleshooting.
• Values are populated automatically during load or sync.
